applies_to: future historical backtests after explicit freeze
purpose: Declare the exact historical inputs admitted to strict point-in-time backtests. This registry is fail-closed and does not itself admit any predictor while unfrozen.
rules: Only sources and fields explicitly listed in admitted_predictors may enter a strict backtest.
Every admitted observation must be PIT-verified under the source-specific evidence contract.
Removing or adding an input after model-skill inspection requires a new registry version and new analysis.
An unfrozen or empty registry cannot satisfy G3.
F-002 and historical G1 v1 are unaffected by this registry.

candidate_predictors.blocker: Historical cutoff admission requires proof that each prior target outcome/taxonomy used by the estimator was authoritatively knowable by the simulated cutoff.
The complete global cohort-year denominator and its frozen vintage policy are not yet available.

research_inputs_not_consumed_by_current_: NTSB sequence phase and causal findings
